title: Enemies Meet
next_chapter_hook: At the very moment Han Lie turned to leave, an aged and urgent voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind—Elder Mo's voice. "Young Master, this old one just intercepted a strand of alien consciousness. Standing behind Han Lie... is the residual will projection of the original owner of the Tianji Record."

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, fine beads of cold sweat forming at his temples. That whisper from before coiled around his soul like a venomous snake—"We shall become one"—what did these six words truly mean? Was it some declaration from the ancient will within Chen Ling toward him, or an even more terrifying prophecy? He drew a sharp breath, his fingertips trembling slightly, yet forcibly suppressed that creeping chill. Whatever that thing was, he had no time to delve into it now, for a premeditated confrontation with an enemy awaited ahead.

The market outside the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate bustled with noise today, yet it wasn't due to ordinary market dealings. The golden banners of the imperial envoy blotted out the sky, the war drums of the Xuanwu Sect made the roof tiles hum, and three thousand armored cavalry had sealed off the entire long street. Common folk could only kneel and tremble on both sides. At the center of the crowd stood a figure blazing like the scorching sun, hands clasped behind their back, the pressure emanating from their body distorting the very air—that was Han Lie, the foremost genius of the Xuanwu Sect, now additionally appointed by the imperial court as the Nation-Protecting Heavenly Martial.

dialogue.content: Hmph, is this all the Tianqing Sect could muster to greet me?

text.content: Han Lie's voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached every ear present. Behind him followed dozens of elite guards in heavy Xuantie armor, each radiating Qi at or above the Golden Core stage. And he himself—reportedly had broken through the Yuan Ying bottleneck three months prior, formally entering the Huashen early stage. Such cultivation, placed anywhere in the entire cultivation world, would be sufficient to establish a sect, yet he was merely thirty-seven years old this year. The surrounding Tianqing Sect disciples stood in terrified silence, none daring to raise their heads to directly gaze upon that blazing figure.

dialogue.content: I hear you Tianqing Sect has some waste named Chen Ji? The one whose three ribs I personally shattered at the Xuanwu martial discussion. What, scared, hiding and afraid to show your face?

text.content: Chen Ji mingled within the crowd, his lips curving slightly beneath the mask. In his heart, he silently recited: Han Lie, your memory serves you well. That battle three years ago, he indeed lost, lost miserably, lost drenched in blood. But what of it? Back then he was merely at Foundation Building early stage, while this insufferable fellow... He had already covertly set up an entire three schemes against Han Lie, each time causing Han Lie to embarrass himself at crucial moments and miss opportunities. But today... something seemed different. That faint trace of sinister gloom lurking in Han Lie's eyes left him with an uneasy feeling.

dialogue.content: Men, bring those wastes up here.

text.content: Several Tianqing Sect Outer Disciples were brutally dragged out by imperial armored soldiers, kneeling at Han Lie's feet. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—these were senior brothers who had once shared the Servants' Quarters with him. Back when he was severely beaten, these individuals had secretly brought him medicinal herbs. Han Lie had actually uncovered this connection? Han Lie was seen trampling on one person's fingers while looking down, laughing wildly: "I hear you fellows were on brotherly terms with that waste Chen Ji? Perfect, deliver a message for me—if he has the guts to still be alive, let him come before me personally. I'll make his death much slower."

Chen Ji's fingers tightened within his sleeves, knuckles turning white. He saw Brother Zhao's fingers crushed, saw Brother Sun's mouth bleeding from a slap, witnessed those who had once shown him kindness being trampled like ants. A fire blazed in his chest, burning his viscera until they trembled. Yet his eyes grew increasingly clear, that rage forcibly suppressed into the deepest recesses of his heart, replaced by bone-deep coldness. In his heart he silently recited: Han Lie, every trace of your arrogance today, every drop of your savagery, I have recorded. What goes around comes around. The time simply hasn't arrived yet.

choice.prompt: Your senior brothers are suffering. How will you choose?

choices.description: Revealing ourselves now would only undo all our efforts. Let Elder Mo record everything. We shall settle accounts with interest later.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain evidence of Han Lie's crimes
choices.risk_hint: May be viewed as a coward

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze, deeply imprinting this scene into his mind. He could sense his Heavenly Fate Value faintly trembling within—that was the Tianji Record automatically recording this karmic debt. Simultaneously, a faint intention transmitted back to Elder Mo's location on the Tianji Record Fragment: Gather all evidence of Han Lie's crimes, starting from today.

choices.text: Covertly contact Ye Qing to intervene
choices.description: Have the Demon Path Saintess use the "Demon Path Mist" to create chaos, rescuing the senior brothers while maintaining anonymity.

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertips moved subtly, a strand of spiritual consciousness undetectable by ordinary people piercing through the void. A moment later, in a corner of the crowd, a woman with her face veiled in black gauze raised one corner of her lips in an amused curve—Ye Qing had received the signal.

choices.text: Directly reveal oneself for a frontal confrontation
choices.description: Since he was singled out and challenged, continuing to hide would only arouse suspicion. Better to make an entrance with a new identity and seize the initiative.
choices.risk_hint: May trigger a deadly confrontation with Han Lie

text.content: As Chen Ji was about to step forward, he saw a commotion ripple through the distant crowd. A middle-aged cultivator in blue robes emerged from the throng—it was the chief disciple of the current Tianqing Sect Master's seat. His appearance caused Han Lie to frown slightly, but also temporarily interrupted Chen Ji's movement.

dialogue.content: What, so scared you don't even dare show your face? Chen Ji, you'll spend your whole life living in a rat hole! Hahahaha!

text.content: Just as Han Lie's laughter reached its most肆无忌惮, a pale purple mist silently spread from the street corner. This mist came eerily, wrapping around the ankles of those imperial soldiers without a sound. In an instant, dozens of elite Jin Dan stage soldiers simultaneously froze in place, their ferocious expressions solidifying into blank confusion. Han Lie frowned, his spiritual sense sweeping out, yet he caught no abnormal spiritual fluctuation. In that moment of distraction, the blue stone slab beneath his feet suddenly exploded. A pitch-black short blade grazed his throat, shearing off a strand of his hair.

dialogue.content: (From a tea house window in the distance, Ye Qing's voice sounded like a specter in Chen Ji's ear) My lord, this sword was merely a warning. If he touches your old acquaintances again, the next sword won't be targeting hair.

text.content: Han Lie's face turned ashen. In thirty-seven years of life, when had he ever suffered such utter humiliation? Having his hair cut in public—that was an insult far more severe than a slap across the face! He flew into a rage, scanning his surroundings, but could only watch as the pale purple mist gradually dissipated, as if it had never existed. "Who?!" His roar made the roof tiles of half the street tremble. "Show yourself!" Yet what answered him was only dead silence and the suppressed snickers of those around—a堂堂镇国天武, actually having his hair shaved on his own territory?

choice.prompt: Han Lie was humiliated in public. How will you end this?

choices.text: Rescue the senior brothers in the chaos
choices.description: While Han Lie was raging and had no attention to spare, let Ye Qing create a passage and quietly transfer the senior brothers.
choices.risk_hint: May allow Han Lie to detect traces

text.content: Another wave of purple mist rose, this time much gentler, like a spring breeze brushing the face. The several senior brothers kneeling on the ground only felt their bodies lighten, their vision blurring. When they came to their senses, they were already in a small woods at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Beside them lay a piece of cloth with only four characters: Rest and recover.

choices.text: Watch coldly and let Han Lie continue to lose face
choices.description: Seize this excellent opportunity to let Han Lie lose face completely. With Ye Qing present, he can't find the real culprit.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie's reputation is thoroughly ruined
choices.risk_hint: May provoke Han Lie to take out his anger on others

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips as he leisurely took out a recording jade slip from his chest. What he wanted wasn't momentary satisfaction, but to completely record Han Lie's狼狈 today. This footage would be the final straw to crush the other party.

Han Lie's chest heaved violently, the veins on his forehead bulging. He spun around abruptly and grabbed the collar of a nearby Imperial Court patron: "Investigate for me! Check every single person who came close just now!" The patron trembled with fear, yet dared not show any evasion, only repeatedly agreeing. What Han Lie didn't know was that the hair just sheared off was quietly lying in the crack of the blue stone slab—Chen Ji had already silently taken it. A strand of hair, for a cultivator, was a medium for casting curses. This debt, he was in no rush to settle. He had plenty of time to calculate slowly.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji... whoever you are, I swear I will crush your bones and scatter your ashes!

text.content: Chen Ji lurked among the crowd, and upon hearing this threat, a flicker of mockery passed through his eyes. He looked down at the strand of Han Lie's hair in his palm, silently reciting: Crush my bones and scatter my ashes? Han Lie, these words, I will remember. When you discover your foundations in the Imperial Court crumbling inch by inch, when everything you built with your own hands turns to nothing, when you kneel before me begging for a quick end—I will make you remember the words you spoke today. He turned and vanished into the depths of the crowd, preparing to return to his lodging to carefully plan today's gains. However, just then, the old voice of Mo Xiansheng suddenly rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Young master, please slow your departure. When this old one was tracking that mist's aura, I unexpectedly caught a fluctuation that should not exist in this world—a spiritual consciousness projection in Han Lie's body that does not belong to him."

Chen Ji came to an abrupt halt, his heart sounding alarm bells. "What do you mean?" he asked inwardly. Mo Xiansheng's voice dropped even lower: "The fluctuation frequency of that projection... bears a seventy percent resemblance to the residual will of the original master of the Tianji Record. In other words—Han Lie has far more than the Empire or the Xuanwu Sect standing behind him. Behind him stands... the Ultimate Chessmaster." Chen Ji's breath stopped at that moment. The Ultimate Chessmaster—that terrifying existence that secretly manipulates countless pieces, treating prophets of every generation as mere tools? It had actually extended its reach to Han Lie?
